findings.title: config() can be called by anyone until the contract is initialized, letting the first caller become admin
prices() does not step the timestamp when a record is missing, so gaps truncate history and TWAPs
div_floor is missing its early return, so zero or negative prices make cross-price reads trap
Asset indexes are truncated to u8 and set_price does not check the update vector length, so more than 256 assets alias each other
Duplicate assets in one add_assets or config batch are accepted
Retention period documented in seconds is used as milliseconds, so history expires after about 90 seconds
Identity cross price returned without checking that the asset has a price
Cross-price division at the call site has no zero or sign guard, so one zero or negative stored price traps every pair read that uses it
